intro.summary: Inner-city southwest community beside Marda Loop and River Park, where 1950s bungalows are steadily replaced by new semi-detached and single-detached infills.
intro.body: Altadore sits in southwest Calgary between the Marda Loop shops on 33 and 34 Avenue SW and the Elbow River, with River Park and Sandy Beach along its eastern edge. Much of its original housing is post-war bungalows on 50-foot lots. Those lots are often split into two 25-foot lots for a pair of new homes, which has made Altadore one of the busiest infill markets in the city.
